segments.he: תּוֹרָה הִיא טַנְתָּ"א. טְעָמִים נְקֻדּוֹת תָּגִין אוֹתִיּוֹת. [ליקו"מ י"ג]
segments.en:
320 harsh judgments (ש"ך דינים = 320) = five times din (judgment) = gematria of na'ar (youth). [Cross-reference from Section 4.]

 ש"ך חסד (320 lovingkindnesses) = gematria of shulchan (table) [see above].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 32

 שככה — משה
 
 Gematria

 Shekachah (שככה, "thus / in this manner") = gematria of Moshe (345). [Cross-reference from Section 13.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 13:3

 שכם — ש'פל כ'וכב מ'לאך
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Shechem (שכם, the city of Shechem / also "shoulder") — first letters of ש׳פל כ׳וכב מ׳לאך: "the fallen star, the angel" — a kabbalistic phrase about the angel that falls and descends.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 9:2

 שלו / שלום
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Shalev (שלו, "tranquil / at peace") — first letters of two verses:

 (1) ו׳ישם ל׳ך ש׳לום — "He shall set peace for you" [cross-reference from Section 6];

 (2) ו׳תורתך ל׳א ש׳כחתי — "Your Torah I have not forgotten" [cross-reference from Section 6].

segments.he: תֶּשִׁי רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת תִּכָּלֵם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים. [ליקו"מ כ"א]
segments.en:
Shalom (שלום, "peace") — first letters of three verses:

 (1) ו׳דע מ׳ה ש׳תשיב ל׳אפיקורוס — "know what to answer a heretic" [cross-ref from Section 6];

 (2) ו׳מגיד ל׳אדם מ׳ה ש׳יחו — "He declares to man what is his meditation" [cross-ref from Section 6];

 (3) ו׳תען ל׳הם מ׳רים ש׳ירו — "And Miriam answered them: Sing!" [cross-ref from Section 6].

 Shalo (שלו) = gematria of three times Havayah plus three times Elokim. [Cross-reference from Section 5.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 46; 62:2; 239; 27:6

 שלושים — נקודות הסגול
 
 Gematria

 Thirty (שלושים = 30) = gematria of the dots of the segol vowel-sign [three dots, each counted according to the gematria framework of lesson 6]. The three dots of the segol sum to 30.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 6:7

 שלושת השריגים — שלשה שרי גאים
 
 Notarikon

 "The three branches" (שלושת השריגים) [Genesis 40:12 — from the butler's dream] are read as שלשה שרי גאים — "three proud princes / three princes of pride." The three branches of the vine encode the three princes of arrogance.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:2; 4

 שלחן — חשמל / ש"ע נהורין / קליפה
 
 Gematria

segments.he: תִּשְׁרֵי גִּימַטְרִיָּא שְׁנֵי פְעָמִים חוֹתָם עִם שְׁנֵי תֵבוֹת. [ליקו"מ כ"ב]
segments.en:
Shulchan (table) gematria cluster — see Shulchan / Shulchan above. Additional cross-references: = chashmal + ten sefirot [Section 8]; = ש"ע נהורין × chai. [All consolidated above.]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §476

 שם — ספר
 
 Gematria

 Shem (שם, "Name" = 340) = gematria of sefer (ספר, "book" = 340). [Cross-reference from Section 15.] A book is a Name.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:32

 שמות — ת'כלית מ'עשה ש'מים ו'ארץ
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Shemos (שמות, "Names" — the Book of Exodus) — first letters of ת׳כלית מ׳עשה ש׳מים ו׳ארץ: "the purpose of the creation of heaven and earth." The Book of Names reveals the purpose of creation.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:39

 שמד / רצון
 
 Gematria

 Shemad (שמד, "forced apostasy / destruction" = 344) and ratzon (רצון, "will / favor" = 346) — the number between them is the gematria of ratzon itself [i.e. 345 = Moshe]. Moshe stands at the midpoint between destruction and divine will — he is the mediator who transforms one into the other. [Cross-reference from Section 13.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 215

 שמחה — אל אלקים ה' דבר
 
 Gematria

 Simchah (שמחה, "joy") = gematria of אל אלקים ה' דבר ("El, Elokim, Hashem spoke" [Psalms 50:1]) together with its letters. [Cross-reference from Section 1.] Joy is the sum of the three divine Names speaking together.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:2; 5

 שמים — אש ומים
 
 Tziroof

Shamayim (שמים, "heaven") = letters of אש ומים ("fire and water"). [Cross-reference from Section 1.] The heavens are a union of fire and water.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 17:2; 80; 88; 114

 שמע — חשמל לב
 
 Gematria

 Shema (שמע = 410) = gematria of chashmal lev (חשמל לב, "the chashmal of the heart" = 410). [Cross-reference from Section 8.] The Shema is the heart's chashmal.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 35:6

 שמע / שכמל"ו — י"ב תיבות / מ"ט אותיות
 
 Notarikon

 The Shema and Baruch Shem (ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לעולם ועד) together contain 12 words corresponding to the 12 tribes, and 49 letters corresponding to the 49 letters in the names of the 12 tribes. [Cross-reference from Section 10.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 36:3

 שמעון
 
 Tziroof

 Shimon (שמעון) — its letters contain מש עון (mash avon, "dissolving iniquity / iniquity of touch"). [Cross-reference from Section 16.]

 Roshay Saveivos

 Shimon — first letters of ע׳יר ו׳קדיש מ׳ן ש׳מיא נ׳חת: "a Watcher, a Holy One, descended from heaven". [Cross-reference from Section 16.] Shimon bar Yochai is the holy watcher who descended.
 
 Sichos HaRan 44; opening of Likutay Mooharan

 שסף — ש'בועות ס'וכות פ'סח
 
 Roshay Saveivos

segments.he: תֵּבֵל גִּימַטְרִיָּא שְׁנֵי פְעָמִים רי"ו, בְּחִינַת מְחָאַת כַּפָּיִם. [ליקו"מ מ"ו]

segments.en:
Safah (שפה, "lip / language") — first letters of ש׳כר פ׳רי ה׳בטן: "the reward of the fruit of the womb" [Psalms 127:3]. The language of holy speech is the fruit of the womb — children are the reward of holy lips.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 48

 שכם — ש'פל כ'וכב מ'לאך
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 [See Shechem above — listed again as cross-reference.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 9:2

 שתיה — ה'ן ת'וי ש'די י'ענני
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Shtiyah (שתיה, "drinking / the Foundation Stone") — first letters of ה׳ן ת׳וי ש׳די י׳ענני: "Behold, the sign of Sha-dai shall answer me." [Cross-reference from Section 5.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 61:6

 שמות האלקיות — Divine Names cluster
 
 Multiple

 The Shin section contains a large cluster of Divine Name (shem) entries — each beginning with the word שם ("Name"). These are collected here:

 Shem Agla (אגלא) — first letters of א׳תה ג׳בור ל׳עולם א׳דני [cross-reference from Section 1]; and its letters are contained in Gildena (golden) [cross-reference from Section 3].

 Shem Atah (א׳ת׳ה׳) — the Name that emerges from the sea, from the verse "You stilled them" (א׳ת׳ה׳ תשבחם) [Psalms 89:10].

 Shem Buchu (בוכ"ו) = gematria of yadcha (Your hand) [cross-reference from Section 10]; emerges from the substitution of the Name Ehyeh.

segments.he: תִּקְעוּ גִּימַטְרִיָּא שְׁנֵי פְעָמִים ע"ב רי"ו, בְּחִינַת מְחָאַת כַּפָּיִם. [שם]
segments.en:
Shem Chav (חב"ו) — first letters of ח׳יל ב׳לע ו׳יקיאנו [cross-reference from Section 8].

 Shem Chesech (חת"ך) = two times ruach; final letters of פותח את ידיך [cross-reference from Sections 8, 17].

 Shem Yabbok (יב"ק) — twice = derech; letters = baki [cross-references from Sections 2, 4, 10].

 Shem Yikov (יק"ו) in full spelling with Alefs = gematria of tal (dew) [cross-reference from Section 9].

 Shem Havayah — its full spelling, full-of-full, and full-of-full-of-full: together the letters = 42; the gematria = three times yad; this equals the Name of 42 [cross-reference from Section 10].

 Shem Mem-Beis (42) = three times yad = Shem Ehyeh + Shem Yikov = 370 lights [cross-references from Sections 10, 11].

 Shem Mah (45) = gematria of Adam [cross-reference from Section 1].

 Shem Sa'el (סא"ל) — first letters of א׳תה ס׳תר ל׳י and of ס׳וף א׳דם ל׳מות [cross-references from Sections 1, 15].

 Shem Samech-Gimel (63) = the opposite of gas ruach (arrogance); emerges from Havayah in full spelling with Yuds; its full spelling = bechiyah (weeping); together with the 10 letters of Havayah = Yom Tov [cross-references from Sections 2, 3, 5, 8, 10].

 Shem Kamah (קמ"ה = 145) — the Name of Yosef's sheaf ("And behold, it arose"); first letters of ה׳שקיפה מ׳מעון ק׳דשך; emerges from the verse about kings rising and falling [cross-references from Sections 6, 12, 13].

segments.he: תְּהִלִּים גִּימַטְרִיָּא לִ-י-לִ-י-ת עִם חֲמִשָּׁה אוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁל שְׁמָהּ. [ליקו"מ ר"ה]
segments.en:
Shem Kuf-Samech-Alef (161) = letters alef-samech-kuf; emerges from Ehyeh in full spelling [cross-references from Sections 1, 7, 10].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:5; 256; 67:7; 6:7; 108; 6:7; 180; 41; 180; II:82; 213; 135; 63; 6:7

 ש'רה א'סתר ב'ת י'הודית ו'י מתה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of the names of the five holy women who died — Sarah, Esther, the daughter of Yehudis, and others — spell מתה ויבאש ("she died and became foul"). [Cross-reference from Section 13.] This entry appears at the end of a story in Sipuray Maasios.
 
 Sichos after Sipuray Maasios

 ש'שים ר'בוא ב'כרס א'חד — בשרא
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "sixty myriads in one belly" spell בשרא (bisra, "flesh"). [Cross-reference from Section 2.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 2

TAV — Numerical Value: 400 | The last letter — the seal of truth | 51 source entries

Hebrew EntryEnglish Translation & ExplanationSource

 ת׳ — סגול + חיריק
 
 Gematria (×2)

 The letter Tav (ת = 400) yields two gematria connections from the same lesson:

 (1) = the segol of the Name קס"א [161] together with the chirik of the Name ס"ג [63] (combined = 400 via a specific calculation);

segments.he: תְּהִלִּים גִּימַטְרִיָּא שְׁנֵי שֵׁמוֹת אֵ"ל אֱלֹהִים בְּמִלּוּאָם. [שם]
segments.en:
(2) = peshutah (simple form) — the plain value of 400.

 [Cross-references from Sections 15, 17.] The last letter, in its simplest form, contains the deepest gematria of the vowel-signs.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 6:7

 ת׳ = נון + חית
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Tav is formed when a Nun and a Ches are joined together. [Cross-reference from Section 14.] The final letter of the alphabet is composed of the 14th (Nun) and 8th (Ches) letters — the letter of the fifty gates and the letter of transcendence.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 1

 ת'אות ר'שעים ת'אבד — תר"ת
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the desire of the wicked shall perish" (ת׳אות ר׳שעים ת׳אבד) [Psalms 112:10] spell תר"ת — the acronym of the three shofar sounds: Tekiah, Shevarim, Teruah (ת׳קיעה ש׳ברים ת׳רועה). The perishing of the wicked's desire is encoded in the shofar call.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:88; Sichos HaRan 180

 תבל — תיו לב / ב' פעמים ריו
 
 Multiple

 Tevel (תבל, "the inhabited world / the earth") yields two connections:

 (1) Tziroof Its letters = ת לב (Tav-Lamed-Beis = Tav + "heart") — the world is the heart of the Tav;

 (2) Gematria Tevel = Reish-Yud-Vov (ריו = 216) twice (432 = 400+30+2). [Cross-reference from Section 20.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:5; 46

segments.he: תַּלְמוּד גִּימַטְרִיָּא אוֹתִיּוֹת לִ-י-לִ-י-ת, לְהַכְנִיעָהּ. [ליקו"מ רי"ד]
segments.en:
תגי דל — יתגדל
 
 Tziroof

 Tagei Dal (תגי דל, "crowns of the poor / the tagin of the Dalet") — its letters are contained in יתגדל (Yisgadal — the opening of Kaddish). [Cross-reference from Section 10.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177

 תהלים
 
 Gematria (×3)

 Tehillim (תהלים, "Psalms" = 485) yields three gematria connections:

 (1) = gematria of El Elokim in full spelling (אלף למד, אלף למד הי יוד מם) [cross-reference from Section 1];

 (2) = gematria of Lilit together with her five letters [cross-reference from Section 12];

 (3) = gematria of tapeh (תפה — see below).

 Sofay Saveivos

 The final letters of ואלה שמות בני ישראל הבאים [Exodus 1:1] spell תהלים. [Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 205

 ת'וכו ר'צוף א'הבה מ'בנות י'רושלים
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

segments.he: תִּשְׁרֵי רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים. [ליקו"מ ח"ב ח']
segments.en:
The first letters of "its interior inlaid with love, by the daughters of Jerusalem" [Song of Songs 3:10] spell both מאירת (me'ires, "illuminating") [cross-reference from Section 13] and ריתמא (rismah, desert camp-station) [cross-reference from Section 20]. Love inlaid in the interior illuminates and becomes a resting-place.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 16

 תולדה — לתודה
 
 Tziroof

 Toledah (תולדה, "offspring / generations") = permutation of LaTodah (לתודה, "for thanksgiving"). [Cross-reference from Section 12.] Generations and thanksgiving are the same letters.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:2; 3

 תולע — עולת
 
 Tziroof

 Tola (תולע, "worm / crimson worm") = permutation of Olas (עולת, "burnt-offering"). [Cross-reference from Section 16.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 28:3

 תורה — י׳ ו׳ / טנת"א
 
 Notarikon

 The Torah embodies the letter-pair Yud-Vov (י׳ ו׳) — Yud = Ten Commandments, Vov = the Tablets (6 × 6 handbreadths). [Cross-reference from Section 10.]

 The Torah = Tanta (טנת"א) — the four levels of letter, crown, vowel, and cantillation. [Cross-reference from Section 9.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 34:6; 38:7; 13:4

 ת'יו ל'ב' — תבל
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Tav [and] thirty-two letters" (ת׳יו ל׳ב׳) spell תבל (tevel, "the world"). The Tav — last letter — combined with the 32 paths of wisdom = the world. [Cross-reference from Tevel above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:5

segments.he: תִּשְׁרֵי סוֹפֵי תֵבוֹת וְאַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת נֶפֶשׁ הַגֵּר כִּי. [שם]
segments.en:
תיקו — תיקון / חסר נון
 
 Notarikon

 Teiku (תיקו — the Talmudic term for an unresolved question, meaning "let it stand") is תיקון (tikkun, "rectification") missing its Nun. The unresolved question is a rectification in waiting — the Nun (= 50, the 50th gate of understanding) has not yet arrived.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan (Remez)

 תיקון — קינות
 
 Tziroof

 Tikkun (תיקון, "rectification") = permutation of kinos (קינות, "Lamentations"). [Cross-reference from Section 19.] Mourning and repair are the same letters.
 
 Likutay Mooharan (Remez)

 ת'כלית מ'עשה ש'מים ו'ארץ — מות
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the purpose of the creation of heaven and earth" (ת׳כלית מ׳עשה ש׳מים ו׳ארץ) spell מות (moves, "death"). The purpose of creation is encoded in the word for death — creation's goal passes through mortality.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:39

 ת'כלם ש'בעת י'מים — תשי
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "she shall be ashamed seven days" (ת׳כלם ש׳בעת י׳מים) [Numbers 12:14 — the words about Miriam's leprosy] spell תשי (teshi, "you have forgotten / weakened"). [Cross-reference: the reverse appears in Tzadi section above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 21:7

 תלמוד — לילית
 
 Gematria

 Talmud (תלמוד = 480) = gematria of Lilit (לילית = 480). [Cross-reference from Section 12.] The Talmud is the precise antidote to the force of nocturnal impurity — the same number, opposite spiritual orientations.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 214

segments.he: תְּרוּמָה סוֹפֵי תֵבוֹת לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם הֲוַיָ"ה וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ [ליקו"מ ח"ב ע"א]
segments.en:
תלת מאה — תלת מה
 
 Notarikon

 Tlas me'ah (תלת מאה, Aramaic: "three hundred") is formed from תלת מה — "three times mah (= 45)" — for 3 × 45 = 135... and also 300 = Shin, the letter of three prongs. Three hundreds emerge from three times the Name of Mah.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 4:9

 תמד — ד' פעמים אלף
 
 Gematria

 Tamad (תמד, "grape juice / a certain mixture") = four times Alef (4 × 111 = 444 = Tav-Mem-Dalet = 400+40+4 = 444). Four times the silent letter produces this specific measure.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 28:3

 תמוז — חסר ו׳
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 Tamuz (תמוז, written deficiently without the Vov as תמז) — first letters of two verses about Torah and Moshe. [Cross-references from Section 7.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 217

 תמר / תֹמשפיל — פלשתים
 
 Gematria

 Tamar (תמר, "date palm / Tamar") = two times the 320 harsh judgments (ש"ך דינים).

 Tziroof

 Tomashpil (תֹמשפיל, "He shall bring low") = permutation of Plishtim (פלשתים, "Philistines"). [Cross-reference from Section 17.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 277; Chayay Mooharan §429

segments.he: תְּהִלִּים תְּשׁוּבָה סוֹפֵי תֵבוֹת וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרָיְמָה אֵת יַעֲקֹב אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ. [ליקו"מ ח"ב ע"ג]
segments.en:
תניא — איתן
 
 Tziroof

 Tanya (תניא, "it has been taught") = permutation of eisahn (איתן, "perennial / mighty"). [Cross-reference from Section 1.] The eternal teaching and eternal strength share their letters.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 15

 ת"פ — לילית
 
 Gematria

 Tav-Peh (ת"פ = 480) = gematria of Lilit. [Cross-reference from Section 12.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 83

 תפה — אל אלקים / תהלים
 
 Gematria

 Tapeh (תפה — a word/name in the source) = gematria of El Elokim in full spelling = gematria of Tehillim = 485. [Cross-references from Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 205

 תפלין — נפתלי
 
 Tziroof

 Tefillin (תפלין, "phylacteries") — its letters are a permutation of נפתלי (Naftali, the tribe). The binding of tefillin and the tribe of Naftali share their letters — Naftali, described as a swift deer, embodies the swift binding of holiness.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 47

 ת'קיעה ש'ברים ת'רועה — קשת / תר"ת
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 The three shofar sounds — Tekiah, Shevarim, Teruah — yield two first-letter acronyms:

segments.he: תְּקִיעָה תְּרוּעָה תְּקִיעָה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד. [ליקו"מ ח"ב פ"ח]
segments.en:
(1) קשת (kashes, "bow / rainbow") [cross-reference from Section 19];

 (2) תר"ת (tarat — the acronym itself, referring to the sequence).

 And: ת'קיעה ת'רועה ת'קיעה — the bracketing pattern of Tekiah-Teruah-Tekiah also spells תר"ת.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 42; II:88; Sichos HaRan 180

 תִּקְעוּ — ע"ב + ריו ב' פעמים
 
 Gematria

 Tik'u (תִּקְעוּ, "blow [the shofar]!" [Psalms 81:4]) = gematria of the Name 72 plus Reish-Yud-Vov twice (72 + 216 + 216 = 504). [Cross-reference from Section 16.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 46

 ת"ק שדי — יתקדש
 
 Tziroof

 Tak Sha-dai (ת"ק שדי, "the power of Sha-dai") — its letters are contained in יתקדש (Yiskadash — the second word of Kaddish). [Cross-reference from Section 10.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 177

 תרדמה — תרגום
 
 Gematria

 Tardemah (תרדמה, "deep sleep" [Genesis 2:21 — G-d's deep sleep upon Adam before creating Eve]) = gematria of תרגום (Targum, "Aramaic translation [of the Torah]"). The deep sleep of creation and the translation of Torah are numerically one — the Aramaic translation reveals what was hidden in the sleep of the original.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 19:4

 תרומה — לחזות' בנועם' ה' ולבקר' בהיכלו'
 
 Sofay Saveivos

segments.he: תְּהִלִּם רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת לִמְטַר הַשָּׁמָיִם תִּשְׁתֶּה מָיִם. [ספר המידות סגולה, חלק שני, ד.]
segments.en:
Terumah (תרומה, "the elevation-offering / priestly gift") — final letters of לחזות בנועם ה׳ ולבקר בהיכלו: "to behold the pleasantness of Hashem and to visit His Sanctuary" [Psalms 27:4]. [Cross-reference from Section 12.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:71

 תרי"ג — משה רבינו
 
 Gematria

 613 (תרי"ג) = gematria of Moshe Rabbeinu (משה רבינו, "Moshe our Teacher"). [Cross-reference from Section 13.] Moshe our Teacher = the 613 commandments.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 36:2

 תרפ"ו אורות — 686 lights
 
 Gematria (×3)

 The 686 lights (תרפ"ו אורות) are encoded in three ways:

 (1) = sum of the seven Divine Names (72+63+45+52+161+151+143) [cross-reference from Section 7];

 (2) = gematria of פורת יוסף ("Poras Yosef" — Yosef the fruitful) [cross-reference from Section 17];

 (3) = gematria of paredeshka (פרדשקא) [cross-reference from Section 17].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 2:2

 תר"ת — ת'אות / ת'קיעה ת'רועה ת'קיעה
 
 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 Tarat (תר"ת — acronym of the three shofar sounds) appears as the first letters of two phrases:

segments.he: תָּמִד גִּימַטְרִיָּא אַרְבָּעָה פְעָמִים אֶלֶף, תִּקּוּן שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מָשָׁל.
segments.en:
(1) ת׳אות ר׳שעים ת׳אבד — "the desire of the wicked shall perish" [Psalms 112:10] [cross-reference from above];

 (2) ת׳קיעה ת׳רועה ת׳קיעה — the bracketing shofar pattern.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:88; Sichos HaRan 180

 תשובה — מצרימה' את' יעקב'
 
 Sofay Saveivos

 Teshuvah (תשובה, "repentance / return") — final letters of the verse describing the descent into Egypt. [Cross-reference from Section 13.] Exile contains the seed of return.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:73

 תשרי
 
 Multiple

 Tishrei (תשרי) — the first and most awesome month of the Jewish year — yields four connections:

 (1) Tziroof Tishrei = expression of shirah (song) [cross-reference from Section 21];

 (2) Gematria Tishrei = two times chosom (seal) with its two words [cross-reference from Section 8];

 (3) Sofay Saveivos Final letters of את נפש הגר כי spell Tishrei [cross-reference from Section 1];

 (4) Roshay Saveivos First letters of י׳ם ש׳ברת ר׳אשי ת׳נינים — "You broke the heads of the sea-monsters" — spell Tishrei [cross-reference from Section 10].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 49:6; 22:11; II:8; 11
